content: 1. Rifapentine reduces the levels of darunavir by enhancing its metabolism through the hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. This combination is contraindicated. 2. Rifapentine decreases the levels or effects of cobicistat by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or consider alternative drugs. 3. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of rimegepant by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism and P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 4. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of rimegepant by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 5. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of riociguat by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism and reducing its metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Monitor for signs of hypotension and adjust the dose if necessary. 6. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of riociguat by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 7. Ritonavir increases the levels or effects of darunavir and cobicistat by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 8. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of rivaroxaban by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Co-administration may increase rivaroxaban exposure and bleeding risk. 9. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of romidepsin by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Avoid co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 10. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of ruxolitinib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Reduce the starting dose of ruxolitinib to 10 mg BID if platelet count is ≥100 x 10^9/L and avoid use if platelet count is <100 x 10^9/L. 11. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of ruxolitinib topical by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Adjust the dose as needed based on platelet count and concurrent CYP3A4 inhibitor use. 12. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of salmeterol by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Co-administration is not recommended due to increased cardiovascular risks, including QT prolongation, palpitations, and sinus tachycardia. 13. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of selpercatinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 14. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of saxagliptin by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 15. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of selumetinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. If co-administration with CYP3A4 inhibitors is unavoidable, reduce the selumetinib dosage as per its monograph. 16. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of selumetinib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Adjust selumetinib dosage if co-administration with CYP3A4 inhibitors is necessary. 17. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of silodosin by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 18. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of siponimod by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Co-administration with moderate/strong CYP3A4 and CYP2C9 inhibitors is not recommended. 19. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of siponimod by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 20. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of sofpironium topical by affecting CYP2D6 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Co-administration with strong CYP2D6 inhibitors may increase sofpironium levels and adverse effects. 21. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of solifenacin by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 22. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of sonidegib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 23. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of sonidegib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 24. Darunavir and sparsentan may increase each other's toxicity through pharmacodynamic synergy. Avoid or use alternative drugs. If unavoidable, interrupt sparsentan treatment. 25. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of sparsentan by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. If unavoidable, interrupt sparsentan treatment and consider dose titration upon resumption. 26. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of sunitinib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 27. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of suvorexant by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Suvorexant is not recommended with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 28. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of suvorexant by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 29. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of tadalafil by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Adjust tadalafil dose for PAH or ED as needed. 30. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of tadalafil by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Adjust tadalafil dose for PAH or ED as needed. 31. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of talazoparib by other mechanisms (e.g., BCRP inhibition). Avoid or use alternative drugs. Monitor for adverse reactions if co-administration is unavoidable. 32. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of tamoxifen by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. CYP3A4 inhibition reduces tamoxifen metabolism to its active metabolite. 33. Cobicistat decreases the effects of tamoxifen by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 34. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of tamsulosin by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 35. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of tamsulosin by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 36. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of tazemetostat by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Avoid co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 37. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of tazemetostat by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Avoid co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 38. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of teniposide by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 39. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of teniposide by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 40. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of ticagrelor by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Ticagrelor is metabolized by CYP3A4/5; avoid use with strong CYP3A inhibitors. 41. Tipranavir increases the levels or effects of cobicistat and darunavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 42. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of tofacitinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Reduce tofacitinib dose to 5 mg daily when co-administered with potent CYP3A4 inhibitors. 43. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of tofacitinib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 44. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of tolterodine by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 45. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of tolvaptan by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 46. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of tolvaptan by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 47. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of topotecan by affecting P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Avoid co-administration with P-gp inhibitors for oral topotecan; the interaction with IV topotecan may be less severe but still clinically significant. 48. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of topotecan by affecting P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 49. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of toremifene by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 50. Tovorafenib decreases the levels or effects of darunavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Avoid co-administration with CYP3A substrates where minimal concentration changes may lead to therapeutic failures. 51. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of trabectedin by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. If a strong CYP3A inhibitor must be used, administer it 1 week after trabectedin infusion and discontinue it the day prior to the next infusion. 52. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of trabectedin by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 53. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of trazodone by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 54. Tucatinib increases the levels or effects of darunavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Avoid co-administration with CYP3A substrates where minimal concentration changes may lead to serious toxicities. 55. Tucatinib increases the levels or effects of cobicistat by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 56. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of ubrogepant by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 57. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of ulipristal by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 58. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of valbenazine by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 59. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of vemurafenib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 60. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of vemurafenib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 61. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of venetoclax by affecting P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Avoid or use alternative drugs. If a P-gp inhibitor must be used, reduce the venetoclax dose by at least 50% and monitor for toxicities. 62. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of vilanterol/fluticasone furoate inhaled by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 63. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of vilazodone by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. If intolerable adverse effects occur, reduce the daily dose to 20 mg. 64. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of vilazodone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 65. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of vincristine liposomal by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 66. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of vorapaxar by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs.
